en.headline: Acting housing chief says 4.4-year public housing wait is 10-year low
en.dek: Wong Wai-lun said the composite waiting time has fallen to 4.4 years and expressed confidence in future supply, including over 36000 traditional units in 2026-27.
body: Acting Financial Secretary and Acting Secretary for Housing Wong Wai-lun said the latest composite waiting time for public rental housing has fallen to 4.4 years, the lowest in a decade.

Speaking on a radio programme on Saturday, Wong said the figure is based on general applicants who were allocated traditional public housing or Light Public Housing in the 12 months to the end of September. It is down 0.4 years from 4.8 years in June and 1.7 years shorter than the 6.1-year peak before the current term of government.

Wong expressed confidence in future traditional public housing supply. He noted that completions in the 2026-27 financial year are expected to exceed 36000 units, the highest in 25 years. Over the five financial years of the current term, traditional public housing supply will exceed 100000 units, averaging 20000 a year, plus 30000 Light Public Housing units.

He also mentioned that a new public housing building control unit with 300 staff began operations this week, replacing the previous independent checking unit, and will handle both existing and new buildings on a project basis.

zh.headline: 署理房屋局長稱公屋綜合輪候時間4.4年為十年新低
zh.dek: 黃偉綸表示綜合輪候時間已降至4.4年，並對未來供應有信心，2026/27年度傳統公屋落成量將逾3.6萬伙。
body: 署理財政司司長兼署理房屋局局長黃偉綸表示，最新公屋綜合輪候時間為4.4年，是過去十年的新低。
黃偉綸周六在電台節目中說，數字根據截至九月底過去12個月獲編配傳統公屋或簡約公屋的一般申請者計算，較六月的4.8年下降0.4年，較本屆政府上任前的高位6.1年縮短1.7年。
他對未來傳統公屋供應表示有信心，指 2026/27年度落成量將超過3.6萬伙，是過去25年的新高。本屆政府五個財政年度傳統公屋供應超過10萬伙，平均每年2萬伙，另加3萬個簡約公屋單位。
黃偉綸亦提到，新成立的公營房屋樓宇管制組本周開始運作，共300人手，取代原有獨立審查組，以項目為基礎處理現有及新興建樓宇。
